name: Quick find
summary: Find a plan, issue, or action by typing: grouped results in an overlay opened from a button, or in a card beside the field.

useWhen: Jumping to a place or running an action by typing a few letters
avoidWhen: The results come from a server search
The results are a page of their own that needs filters and paging

accessibility: In Overlay, the trigger opens a dialog named Quick find: focus moves to the Find field, arrow keys move through the results, Enter runs one, and Escape closes the overlay and returns focus to the trigger.
In Inline, the SearchField is named Find and the ListBox is named Results: the list is one Tab stop, and arrow keys move between results.
The inline result count, and the item you chose, are a role=status element.
Group headings name their results, and an empty search shows a plain message.
unsupported: Searching a server or ranking results of your own: Overlay filters five placeholder commands by title, subtitle, group, and keywords through useCommandPalette, and Inline filters five placeholder items by title
Running the chosen action: choosing only reports its title
workflowValue: Replaces wiring a find box by hand: one query filters grouped items and one status line reports the count or the choice, so you swap the items and pick the overlay or the inline card.
